articles.title: Ross Gerber Warns Tesla's Technology Edge Is 'Fading' As FSD Moves To Subscription-Only Model
articles.mainIdea: Ross Gerber Warns Tesla's Technology Edge Is 'Fading' As FSD Moves To Subscription-Only Model
articles.summary: Benzinga: Ross Gerber Warns Tesla's Technology Edge Is 'Fading' As FSD Moves To Subscription-Only Model. Investor Ross Gerber, co-founder of Gerber Kawasaki, has expressed concern about Tesla Inc. (NASDAQ:TSLA) CEO Elon Musk's move to only offer Full Self-Driving as a subscription service starting next month. Tesla's Software Edge Fading In a post on the social media platform X on Wednesday, the investor shared that Tesla's decision to offer FSD was “the first step” for the automaker towards "giving away the software," which Gerber says will be "standard on vehicles over the next five years."
